{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the channel column
channel_distribution = sales_df['channel'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of converted
converted_distribution = sales_df['converted'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
segment_distribution = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Print results
print("Missing values:\n", missing_values)
print("\nDuplicates:", duplicates)
print("\nChannel distribution:\n", channel_distribution)
print("\nConverted distribution:\n", converted_distribution)
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:\n", segment_distribution)"}
